text:
elaine: Heads-up: Stratus marketplace listing goes live next week. Can we run a short partner SEV drill Fri 11/10 09:30 PT to validate shared-channel alerts, bridge creation, and pager handoffs? Who from Stratus/SI should join? :calendar:

samir: 09:30 PT works. Keep it to one scenario (sev2) and a 30m box. I can cover escalation policy drafting.

lucy: I'll coordinate the war-room flow. Proposed steps:
- create shared channel #partners-stratus-drill and war room #stratus-warroom
- invite Priya (Stratus oncall), Omar (SI infra), Anya (marketplace PM), elaine, samir, mike
- confirm deploy-bot posts bridge link and pages rotation

mike: I can automate channel creation and bot mapping. Sample routing entry for ops config:
```
partners/stratus: rotation=redwood-oncall-stratus; auto_bridge=true; ack_secs=300
```
deploy-bot: Created test channels in staging. Bridge placeholder: https://zoom.example/warroom-1939999000

partners-rep-stratus: Priya will join. Omar can join for the first 20m. Need bridge link before start.

elaine: lucy/mike please own channel + bot setup. samir I’ll ask you to draft the escalation doc. I’ll send calendar + invites.

samir: On ack timing: bot should ping rotation immediately on `sev:` tag. If no ack in 5m, open bridge and page eng-sev. That minimizes noisy pages.

lucy: Agreed. Quick flow summary we will test:
1) partner posts in #partners-stratus-drill with `sev:2`
2) deploy-bot relays to #stratus-warroom and alerts rotation
3) 5m no ack -> bot opens bridge and pages eng-sev + marketplace-ops if listing impacted

elaine: Great. Action owners: lucy/mike = channels + bot, samir = escalation doc, elaine = invites. React with :white_check_mark: when you own it.

mike: Pushed staging config and scheduled channel creation for Fri 09:20 PT. Will drop bridge link automatically.

partners-rep-stratus: Confirmed attendees and timing. See you Fri 09:30 PT.

elaine: Thanks all. We'll record the drill and capture time-to-ack and handoff notes in a short doc for follow-up. :thumbsup:
